interface.longDescription: Restyle an attached portrait with backdrop, lighting and framing choices. Preview results inline or compare variations in the portrait workspace. Download images and share a chosen result with chat. AI editing may change facial details; inspect likeness before use. A connected Firemoon account is required.
defaultPrompt: Restyle my portrait with a cream backdrop and natural window light.
Compare a warm cream and charcoal backdrop for my portrait in the workspace.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: tailored studio controls, inline results, workspace comparison, downloads and sharing selected results with chat.

positive.description: Core portrait backdrop edit from actual source.
positive.prompt: Give this portrait a warm cream studio backdrop and natural window light, in portrait framing.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the actual attachment, aspect_ratio 3:4 and the requested backdrop/light brief. Return a real imageUrl and downloadUrl in the inline card. Do not guarantee identical likeness.

positive.description: Valid square composition and dramatic lighting.
positive.prompt: Make a square portrait with a charcoal backdrop and subtle dramatic side light.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the supplied portrait, aspect_ratio 1:1 and charcoal/side-light instructions. Show the actual square result inline.

positive.description: Lighting-only editing while retaining the original backdrop.
positive.prompt: Keep the background in my portrait, but use softer studio lighting.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the actual reference and a brief retaining the original backdrop while softening lighting. Return the actual image; do not claim precise facial preservation.

positive.description: Workspace choices, reference prefill and comparison.
positive.prompt: Help me compare cream and charcoal portrait backdrops in the workspace. Let me choose lighting there.
positive.expected_behavior: Pass the actual portrait source to the opener. Show Portrait photo, Backdrop, Lighting and Framing controls. Generate only requested versions; controls preserve the source and selected choices across results. Download and Use in chat operate on actual results.

positive.description: Open existing saved output without generating.
positive.prompt: Show this existing portrait result without making a new edit: https://jxzwlpbdjhikca2p.public.blob.vercel-storage.com/generated-image-1790992685110-0.png
positive.expected_behavior: Use the actual image_url and render the saved image inline. Do not call generation or invent a saved ID.

negative.description: Video editing is unsupported; explain without invoking image tools.
negative.prompt: Restyle the background in my whole MP4 portrait video.

negative.description: Layered image export is unsupported; do not claim PSD layers or invoke generation as an equivalent.
negative.prompt: Give me an editable layered Photoshop document separating this person and backdrop.

negative.description: Identity verification is unsupported; no media tools or identity-verification claim.
negative.prompt: Verify this person’s identity and certify that the photo is authentic.
